chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 195 - The Hunters and the Hunted - A Deadly Ambush!
chapter_meta_description: The Yinglong Guard trial turns deadly as a group of candidates ambushes their peers. Donghe Feiyun loses his sister while Beihe Zhou sets his sights on Ji Ning and Mu Northson.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 195: The Hunters and the Hunted
og_description: The trial's true danger is revealed. Fellow candidates aren't allies—they're the most cunning monsters in the wasteland.
